name: Qwen3.8 27B
notes: Released Aug 5 2026. Dense hybrid (Gated DeltaNet + gated attention) LM with vision encoder; 27.8B incl. vision tower (27B LM); text-only use fine, mmproj optional. Highest-quality model in this catalog: Qwen card GPQA-Diamond 89.2, IFBench 79.5, SWE-bench Pro 61.7; Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 small-class (4-40B) co-leader (20 at xhigh effort, tied with Nanbeige4.3-33B; 17 medium, 16 low, 10 non-reasoning). THINKING model: <think>...</think> on by default; chat-template kwargs enable_thinking=false (direct answers), reasoning_effort xhigh(default)/medium/low, preserve_thinking (default true) - use the GGUF's embedded Jinja template (llama.cpp --jinja). llama.cpp arch qwen35, supported since b7990 (Feb 10 2026, PR #19468). Unsloth dynamic (UD) quants chosen because they are much smaller than standard imatrix quants at equal bit-width (UD-IQ3_XXS 10.93GB vs bartowski IQ3_XXS 12.32GB); caveats: unsloth's embedded chat template is modified vs Qwen's original and these files contain no MTP layers. Alternative: bartowski/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF (original template, built-in MTP layers for --spec-type draft-mtp; IQ2_M 10.52GB, IQ3_XXS 12.32GB, Q3_K_M 13.40GB). Device fit: 16GB iPad for UD-Q2_K_XL/UD-IQ3_XXS; UD-IQ2_XXS is the only realistic 12GB-device option (expect clear 2-bit quality loss). Dense 27B => slowest decode in the catalog. Requested quant types not published in this repo: IQ3_M, Q3_K_M, Q3_K_L, IQ2_M. Omitted as >13.5GB: UD-Q4_K_M 16.46GB, UD-Q5_K_M 19.77GB, UD-Q6_K 21.98GB, Q8_0 29.05GB, UD-IQ4_XS 14.25GB, Q4_0 16.06GB.

name: Qwen3.6 35B-A3B
notes: Released Apr 2026. MoE (256 experts, 8 routed + 1 shared, ~3B active) with vision encoder; very fast decode for its quality (GPQA-Diamond 86.0, SWE-bench Verified 73.4 as listed in Ornith's comparison table). THINKING model: on by default (enable_thinking=false to disable; preserve_thinking supported); embedded Jinja template required. llama.cpp arch qwen35moe since b7990 (Feb 10 2026). Only ~2-3-bit unsloth dynamic quants fit under 13.5GB, so 16GB iPad only. Unsloth template modified vs original; no MTP layers. Alternative: bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF (original template + MTP; IQ2_M 12.96GB). See also ornith-1.5-35b-a3b (same architecture, stronger vendor scores). Requested quant types not published in this repo: Q4_0, IQ3_M, Q3_K_L. Omitted as >13.5GB: UD-Q4_K_M 22.13GB, UD-Q5_K_M 26.46GB, UD-Q6_K 29.31GB, Q8_0 36.90GB, UD-IQ4_XS 17.73GB, MXFP4_MOE 21.71GB, UD-Q3_K_M 16.60GB.

name: Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B
notes: Released Aug 18 2026. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-architecture MoE (~3B active, vision encoder included) further trained with Ornith's self-improving RL loop. Ornith's table vs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B: GPQA-Diamond 89.2 vs 86.0, SWE-bench Verified 79.0 vs 73.4, Terminal-Bench 2.1 67.8 vs 52.5, but MMLU-Pro 80.8 vs 82.7. ~4M GGUF downloads/month for the official repo. THINKING model (<think> by default). Context 262,144. llama.cpp arch qwen35moe (b7990+). The official ornith-ai/Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-GGUF only publishes Q4_K_M (21.71GB) and larger, so bartowski supplies the 2-bit sizes; caveat: bartowski embeds the stock Qwen template, while the official GGUF embeds Ornith's modified template (Unsloth-style developer-role/tool-call fixes, merged system messages, reasoning kept in history) - consider overriding with it. Only ~2-bit fits: 16GB iPad only. Omitted as >13.5GB: Q4_K_M 21.86GB, Q5_K_M 25.49GB, Q6_K 30.53GB, Q8_0 37.81GB, IQ4_XS 19.28GB, Q4_0 20.42GB, IQ3_XXS 15.34GB, IQ3_M 17.37GB, Q3_K_M 16.70GB, Q3_K_L 17.36GB.

name: Gemma 4 26B-A4B IT
notes: Released Apr 2026. MoE (128 experts, 8 active + 1 shared; 3.8B active) with vision encoder (mmproj optional). Gemma 4 chat format (<|turn>role ... <turn|>). THINKING optional, OFF by default: kwarg enable_thinking=true inserts <|think|> in the system turn; thoughts come back as <|channel>thought ... <channel|> and must be stripped from history; when thinking is off this size still emits an empty thought block. llama.cpp arch gemma4 since b8637 (Apr 2 2026, PR #21309); use a build from ~Apr 10 2026 or later for tokenizer/template-parser fixes (#21343, #21418, #21492, #21704). bartowski chosen: embedded template byte-identical to Google's and it publishes the exact IQ2_M/IQ3_XXS/Q3_K_M/Q3_K_L/IQ3_M low-bit set under 13.5GB. Alternatives: unsloth/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF (smaller UD quants, e.g. UD-IQ2_M 10.01GB, UD-IQ3_XXS 11.42GB; modified template); google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf (official QAT Q4_0, 14.44GB - too big). 16GB iPad only. Omitted as >13.5GB: Q4_K_M 17.04GB, Q5_K_M 19.32GB, Q6_K 22.86GB, Q8_0 26.86GB, IQ4_XS 14.21GB, Q4_0 14.76GB.

name: gpt-oss-20b
notes: Released Aug 2025; still OpenAI's newest small open-weight chat model as of Nov 2026 (the openai HF org shows no newer gpt-oss chat model - only gpt-oss-safeguard-20b/120b (Sep 2025) and non-chat releases). MoE (32 experts, 4 active) with natively MXFP4 experts, so the MXFP4 GGUF is the canonical quant; other quant types barely shrink it (unsloth/gpt-oss-20b-GGUF Q2_K..Q8_0 are all 11.47-12.11GB). REASONING model using the Harmony format (analysis/commentary/final channels); set effort via system prompt ('Reasoning: low|medium|high'); requires llama.cpp's Jinja + Harmony parsing (--jinja). Context 131,072. llama.cpp arch gpt-oss since b6096 (Aug 5 2025, PR #15091). Repo also has an EAGLE3 draft model (eagle3-gpt-oss-20b-Q8_0.gguf) not listed. 16GB iPad only.

name: LFM2.5 24B-A2B
notes: Released Oct 2026. Text-only hybrid (gated short-conv + attention) MoE, 64 experts / 4 active (2.45B active) - the fastest decode of the 20B+ tier and the most practical 20B+ option on 12GB devices (UD-IQ2_M 7.54GB, UD-IQ3_XXS 8.96GB). Pure REASONING model: always thinks (<think> in template; preserve_thinking kwarg). Liquid positions it for on-device agents/tool use and recommends pairing with retrieval for knowledge-heavy questions. Context 131,072. llama.cpp arch lfm2moe (PR #16464, Oct 2025) plus LFM2.5 128K-vocab tokenizer support (PR #23826, merged May 29 2026, approx b9402-b9415) and LFM2/2.5 chat-parser fixes (#24178, #24234, Jun 2026). unsloth chosen because the official LiquidAI/LFM2.5-24B-A2B-GGUF only has Q4_K_M (14.53GB) and QAD-Q4_0 (13.58GB) and up. License is Liquid's custom LFM Open License v1.0 - review commercial terms. Requested quant types not published in this repo: Q4_K_M, Q5_K_M, Q6_K, IQ4_XS, Q4_0, IQ3_M, Q3_K_M, Q3_K_L. Omitted as >13.5GB: Q8_0 25.49GB.

name: Muse Glimmer 30B
notes: Released Aug 2026; Meta's 2026 open-weight small model (distilled from Muse Spark; no new Llama-branded small model in 2026). Dense transformer + perception (vision) encoder; 29.6-29.8B incl. encoder. REASONING model with controllable effort: add 'Reasoning strength: <level>' to the system prompt. Context 131,072. llama.cpp arch muse-glimmer since b10353 (Aug 10 2026, PR #26841); chat/tool-call fixes through Sep 29 2026 (#26879, #29242, #29615). Caveat: bartowski/unsloth GGUFs embed an older chat template (7,167 chars) than the current official one (9,992 chars in meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B and meta-models/Muse-Glimmer-30B-GGUF) - consider overriding with the official template. Official meta-models GGUF only has Q4_K_M (16.76GB) and Q4_K_XL (19.65GB). Scores below Qwen3.8-27B on Qwen's card (GPQA-D 83.5 vs 89.2); AA Index v5.0: 6. 16GB iPad only; dense 30B at 2-3 bit will be slow. Omitted as >13.5GB: Q4_K_M 17.31GB, Q5_K_M 20.11GB, Q6_K 23.41GB, Q8_0 29.61GB, IQ4_XS 15.44GB, Q4_0 16.27GB, Q3_K_M 13.96GB, Q3_K_L 14.78GB.

name: Gemma 4 12B IT
notes: Released May 23 2026 ('unified' Gemma 4 12B; dense, text+image+audio capable, text-only use fine). Gemma 4 chat format and thinking controls (thinking OFF by default; enable_thinking=true adds <|think|>; strip <|channel>thought blocks from history). Card context 256K; this repo's GGUF metadata reports context_length 131,072 (unsloth/ggml-org/Google GGUFs report 262,144) - irrelevant on-device. llama.cpp: gemma4 arch (b8637) plus the 12B 'unified' variant support from PR #24077 (merged Jun 3 2026, first in a build between b9490 and b9496; mmproj FPE fix in b9496). bartowski template is byte-identical to Google's. Higher-quality 4-bit alternatives from QAT checkpoints: google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf -> gemma-4-12b-it-qat-q4_0.gguf (6,975,879,296 bytes) and unsloth/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-GGUF -> gemma-4-12B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf (6,716,356,800 bytes). Fits 12GB devices at Q4/IQ4.

name: Ministral 3 14B Instruct 2512
notes: Released Dec 2025; still Mistral's newest small dense chat model as of Nov 2026 (Mistral Small 4 is 119B MoE; no new Magistral small release found). 13.5B LM + 0.4B vision encoder. NON-thinking instruct model (fast, direct answers); a separate Ministral-3-14B-Reasoning-2512 (official mistralai GGUF, unsloth) exists. Mistral recommends temperature < 0.1. Context 262,144. llama.cpp arch mistral3; use a build >= ~b7363 (Dec 12 2025, PR #17945 attn_factor fix for Ministral 3) - parser added in PR #17713. bartowski chosen: full quant set and embedded template byte-identical to the official mistralai GGUF (unsloth's differs); official mistralai/Ministral-3-14B-Instruct-2512-GGUF only has Q4_K_M/Q5_K_M/Q8_0. Fits 12GB devices at Q4. Omitted as >13.5GB: Q8_0 14.36GB.

name: Ornith 1.5 9B
notes: Released Aug 18-19 2026. Qwen3.5-9B-architecture model (vision encoder included; text-only fine) trained further with a self-improving RL loop; strongest ~9B on vendor numbers (GPQA-Diamond 86.4 vs Qwen3.5-9B 81.7; HLE 20.2 vs 14.7; SWE-bench Verified 70.6 vs 53.2). Very widely used (~5.4M GGUF downloads). THINKING model (<think> by default; vLLM/SGLang use the qwen3 reasoning parser). Uses a modified Qwen chat template - the official GGUF embeds it, bartowski's has the stock Qwen template. Context 262,144 (YaRN to ~1M). Official files include MTP layers (GGUF param count 9.20B). llama.cpp arch qwen35 (b7990+). For IQ4_XS/Q4_0/IQ3 sizes use bartowski/Ornith-1.5-9B-GGUF. Fits 12GB devices at Q4/Q5. Requested quant types not published in this repo: IQ4_XS, Q4_0.

name: Qwen3.5 9B
notes: Released Feb 2026. Dense hybrid Gated-DeltaNet LM + vision encoder (text-only fine). THINKING model, on by default (enable_thinking=false for direct answers). Context 262,144. llama.cpp arch qwen35 since b7990 (Feb 10 2026). bartowski chosen: embedded template identical to Qwen's original and files include MTP layers usable for self-speculative decoding (--spec-type draft-mtp, llama.cpp b9180+). Cost: ~0.5GB larger than unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF (Q4_K_M 5.68GB, modified template, no MTP). Base for Ornith-1.5-9B and MiMo-V2.6-Distill, which beat it on reasoning/agentic benchmarks.

name: MiMo-V2.6 Distill Qwen 9B
notes: Released Sep 21 2026. SFT of Qwen3.5-9B on MiMo-V2.6-generated data (agentic/coding/general); Xiaomi reports large gains over Qwen3.5-9B (SWE-bench Pro 44.6 vs 32.0, Terminal-Bench 2.1 37.1 vs 27.0, Toolathlon 35.2 vs 25.9). THINKING model, on by default (template emits an empty <think></think> when enable_thinking=false). Context 262,144. llama.cpp arch qwen35 (b7990+). bartowski's card has no license metadata (base model is MIT); embedded template identical to Xiaomi's. ggml-org/MiMo-V2.6-Distill-Qwen-9B-GGUF only has Q8_0. Fits 12GB devices at Q4/Q5.

name: Granite 4.2 8B
notes: Released Aug 2026 (card date Aug 25 2026). Dense reasoning model on the classic 'granite' arch (llama.cpp support since 2024, PR #9412 - any 2026 build). THINKING on by default; kwargs enable_thinking=false, reasoning_effort='low' (low-effort mode); prior-turn thinking truncated by default. Strong tool calling. Card: 128K native, 512K with extension; GGUF context 131,072. IBM numbers: AIME25 86.7, GPQA 64.1, MMLU-Pro 74.0, LiveCodeBench v6 73.2. Artificial Analysis Index v5.0: 5. Official repo has no IQ4_XS (bartowski/granite-4.2-8b-GGUF does). Requested quant types not published in this repo: IQ4_XS.

name: Qwen3.5 4B
notes: Released Feb-Mar 2026. Best general-knowledge/reasoning ~4B on vendor numbers (MMLU-Pro 79.1, GPQA-Diamond 76.2). Hybrid Gated-DeltaNet LM + vision encoder (text-only fine). THINKING on by default (enable_thinking=false for quick replies). Context 262,144 (small KV footprint thanks to linear-attention layers). llama.cpp arch qwen35 since b7990. bartowski: original template + MTP layers (--spec-type draft-mtp). Smaller alternative: unsloth/Qwen3.5-4B-GGUF (Q4_K_M 2.74GB; modified template, no MTP). Recommended iPhone default.

name: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B
notes: Released Oct 23 2026. Gemma-4-E4B-it post-trained by NVIDIA for on-device chat, instruction following, role-play and tool use; NVIDIA reports wins over Gemma 4 E4B and Qwen3.5-4B on most chat/IF evals (IFBench 63.8 vs 42.8/58.9; MultiChallenge 53.1 vs 42.1/51.8) but Qwen3.5-4B stays ahead on Tau2/BFCL. 8B incl. per-layer embeddings, ~4-4.5B effective. THINKING on by default (enable_thinking=false; NVIDIA documents a two-pass thinking-budget client); Gemma 4 chat format; extra 'conversational_mode' template kwarg. Context 64K (GGUF 65,536). License OpenMDW-1.1 per NVIDIA card (bartowski's card has no license metadata; ggml-org's copy is tagged apache-2.0). llama.cpp arch gemma4 (b8637+). Official single file: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-4GB -> Nemotron-3.5-Bolt-E4B-Q4_K_M.gguf (6,180,446,208 bytes, sha256 c8af2b8aea10a690a1d9491db744a9446660173cb38fc489612b556615a69612).

name: Gemma 4 E4B IT
notes: Released Apr 2026. 4.5B effective (8B with per-layer embeddings); text+image+audio capable, text-only fine. Gemma 4 chat format (<|turn>...<turn|>); thinking OFF by default (enable_thinking=true adds <|think|>; E-models emit no empty thought block when off). Context 131,072. llama.cpp arch gemma4 since b8637 (Apr 2 2026); prefer builds from ~Apr 10 2026+. bartowski template identical to Google's. Alternatives: google/gemma-4-E4B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf -> gemma-4-E4B_q4_0-it.gguf (5,154,941,280 bytes, official QAT); unsloth/gemma-4-E4B-it-GGUF (Q4_K_M 4.98GB, modified template).

name: Granite 4.2 3B
notes: Released Aug 2026. Dense reasoning model ('granite' arch, any 2026 llama.cpp build). Top of Artificial Analysis' tiny (<=4B) open-model list (Index v5.0: 4.7). Same thinking kwargs as Granite 4.2 8B (enable_thinking default true; reasoning_effort='low'). IBM numbers: AIME25 78.3, GPQA 54.8, MMLU-Pro 67.8 (weaker knowledge than Qwen3.5-4B's vendor numbers). GGUF context 131,072 (512K with extension per card). Official repo has no IQ4_XS (bartowski/granite-4.2-3b-GGUF does). Requested quant types not published in this repo: IQ4_XS.

name: LFM3 1.7B
notes: Released Oct 23-27 2026. Text-only tri-hybrid (13 gated short-conv + 5 sliding-window + 6 global-attention layers), 256K context; built for fast on-device agents. REASONING on by default (enable_thinking=false possible but 'can be inconsistent' per card; preserve_thinking kwarg). Liquid's table: avg 49.4 vs Qwen3.5-4B 39.3 / Qwen3.5-9B 47.2 (agent-heavy mix; IFEval 96.7, IFBench 73.0) but weaker knowledge (GPQA-D 63.4 vs 75.8 for Qwen3.5-4B). NEWEST ARCH: lfm3 first appears in llama.cpp b11938 (Oct 27 2026, PR #31252); Liquid says use b11960 (v0.8.0) or newer - bundle a very recent llama.cpp. QAD-Q4_0 = quantization-aware-distilled Q4_0 (Liquid's recommended 4-bit). Sampling: temp 0.1, top_k 50, repeat_penalty 1.1 (math/science: temp 1.0, top_p 0.95, top_k 20). Files are 1.05-1.85GB (below the 1.5GB floor except Q8_0). Requested quant types not published in this repo: IQ4_XS.

name: Gemma 4 E2B IT
notes: Released Apr 2026. 2.3B effective (5.1B with per-layer embeddings); fastest Gemma 4, multimodal-capable. Same chat-format/thinking notes as Gemma 4 E4B (thinking off by default). Context 131,072. llama.cpp arch gemma4 since b8637 (prefer ~Apr 10 2026+). Alternatives: google/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-q4_0-gguf -> gemma-4-E2B_q4_0-it.gguf (3,349,516,256 bytes, official QAT); unsloth/gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-mobile-GGUF -> gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-UD-Q2_K_XL.gguf (2,186,186,784 bytes, from Google's mobile QAT checkpoint).
